005package org.wpilib.math.geometry;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Meters;
008
009import java.util.Objects;
010import org.wpilib.math.geometry.proto.Transform2dProto;
011import org.wpilib.math.geometry.struct.Transform2dStruct;
012import org.wpilib.math.linalg.MatBuilder;
013import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
014import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N3;
015import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
016import org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance;
017import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable;
018import org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable;
019
020/**
021 * Represents a transformation for a Pose2d in the pose's frame.
022 *
023 * <p>Transforms are applied intrinsically, i.e. relative to the pose's own frame rather than the
024 * global frame. This is in contrast to the rotation classes, which apply rotations extrinsically.
025 */
026public final class Transform2d implements ProtobufSerializable, StructSerializable {
027  /**
028   * A preallocated Transform2d representing no transformation.
029   *
030   * <p>This exists to avoid allocations for common transformations.
031   */
032  public static final Transform2d ZERO = new Transform2d();
033
034  private final Translation2d m_translation;
035  private final Rotation2d m_rotation;
036
037  /**
038   * Constructs the transform that maps the initial pose to the final pose.
039   *
040   * @param initial The initial pose for the transformation.
041   * @param last The final pose for the transformation.
042   */
043  public Transform2d(Pose2d initial, Pose2d last) {
044    // To transform the global translation delta to be relative to the initial
045    // pose, rotate by the inverse of the initial pose's orientation.
046    m_translation =
047        last.getTranslation()
048            .minus(initial.getTranslation())
049            .rotateBy(initial.getRotation().unaryMinus());
050
051    m_rotation = last.getRotation().relativeTo(initial.getRotation());
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Constructs a transform with the given translation and rotation components.
056   *
057   * @param translation Translational component of the transform.
058   * @param rotation Rotational component of the transform.
059   */
060  public Transform2d(Translation2d translation, Rotation2d rotation) {
061    m_translation = translation;
062    m_rotation = rotation;
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Constructs a transform with x and y translations instead of a separate Translation2d.
067   *
068   * @param x The x component of the translational component of the transform.
069   * @param y The y component of the translational component of the transform.
070   * @param rotation The rotational component of the transform.
071   */
072  public Transform2d(double x, double y, Rotation2d rotation) {
073    m_translation = new Translation2d(x, y);
074    m_rotation = rotation;
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Constructs a transform with x and y translations instead of a separate Translation2d. The X and
079   * Y translations will be converted to and tracked as meters.
080   *
081   * @param x The x component of the translational component of the transform.
082   * @param y The y component of the translational component of the transform.
083   * @param rotation The rotational component of the transform.
084   */
085  public Transform2d(Distance x, Distance y, Rotation2d rotation) {
086    this(x.in(Meters), y.in(Meters), rotation);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Constructs a transform with the specified affine transformation matrix.
091   *
092   * @param matrix The affine transformation matrix.
093   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the affine transformation matrix is invalid.
094   */
095  public Transform2d(Matrix<N3, N3> matrix) {
096    m_translation = new Translation2d(matrix.get(0, 2), matrix.get(1, 2));
097    m_rotation = new Rotation2d(matrix.block(2, 2, 0, 0));
098    if (matrix.get(2, 0) != 0.0 || matrix.get(2, 1) != 0.0 || matrix.get(2, 2) != 1.0) {
099      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Affine transformation matrix is invalid");
100    }
101  }
102
103  /** Constructs the identity transform -- maps an initial pose to itself. */
104  public Transform2d() {
105    m_translation = Translation2d.ZERO;
106    m_rotation = Rotation2d.ZERO;
107  }
108
109  /**
110   * Multiplies the transform by the scalar.
111   *
112   * @param scalar The scalar.
113   * @return The scaled Transform2d.
114   */
115  public Transform2d times(double scalar) {
116    return new Transform2d(m_translation.times(scalar), m_rotation.times(scalar));
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Divides the transform by the scalar.
121   *
122   * @param scalar The scalar.
123   * @return The scaled Transform2d.
124   */
125  public Transform2d div(double scalar) {
126    return times(1.0 / scalar);
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Composes two transformations. The second transform is applied relative to the orientation of
131   * the first.
132   *
133   * @param other The transform to compose with this one.
134   * @return The composition of the two transformations.
135   */
136  public Transform2d plus(Transform2d other) {
137    return new Transform2d(Pose2d.ZERO, Pose2d.ZERO.transformBy(this).transformBy(other));
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Returns the translation component of the transformation.
142   *
143   * @return The translational component of the transform.
144   */
145  public Translation2d getTranslation() {
146    return m_translation;
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Returns the X component of the transformation's translation.
151   *
152   * @return The x component of the transformation's translation.
153   */
154  public double getX() {
155    return m_translation.getX();
156  }
157
158  /**
159   * Returns the Y component of the transformation's translation.
160   *
161   * @return The y component of the transformation's translation.
162   */
163  public double getY() {
164    return m_translation.getY();
165  }
166
167  /**
168   * Returns the X component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
169   *
170   * @return The x component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
171   */
172  public Distance getMeasureX() {
173    return m_translation.getMeasureX();
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Returns the Y component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
178   *
179   * @return The y component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
180   */
181  public Distance getMeasureY() {
182    return m_translation.getMeasureY();
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Returns an affine transformation matrix representation of this transformation.
187   *
188   * @return An affine transformation matrix representation of this transformation.
189   */
190  public Matrix<N3, N3> toMatrix() {
191    var vec = m_translation.toVector();
192    var mat = m_rotation.toMatrix();
193    return MatBuilder.fill(
194        Nat.N3(),
195        Nat.N3(),
196        mat.get(0, 0),
197        mat.get(0, 1),
198        vec.get(0),
199        mat.get(1, 0),
200        mat.get(1, 1),
201        vec.get(1),
202        0.0,
203        0.0,
204        1.0);
205  }
206
207  /**
208   * Returns the rotational component of the transformation.
209   *
210   * @return Reference to the rotational component of the transform.
211   */
212  public Rotation2d getRotation() {
213    return m_rotation;
214  }
215
216  /**
217   * Returns a Twist2d of the current transform (pose delta). If b is the output of {@code a.log()},
218   * then {@code b.exp()} would yield a.
219   *
220   * @return The twist that maps the current transform.
221   */
222  public Twist2d log() {
223    final double dtheta = m_rotation.getRadians();
224    final double halfDtheta = dtheta / 2.0;
225
226    final double cosMinusOne = m_rotation.getCos() - 1;
227
228    double halfThetaByTanOfHalfDtheta;
229    if (Math.abs(cosMinusOne) < 1E-9) {
230      halfThetaByTanOfHalfDtheta = 1.0 - 1.0 / 12.0 * dtheta * dtheta;
231    } else {
232      halfThetaByTanOfHalfDtheta = -(halfDtheta * m_rotation.getSin()) / cosMinusOne;
233    }
234
235    Translation2d translationPart =
236        m_translation
237            .rotateBy(new Rotation2d(halfThetaByTanOfHalfDtheta, -halfDtheta))
238            .times(Math.hypot(halfThetaByTanOfHalfDtheta, halfDtheta));
239
240    return new Twist2d(translationPart.getX(), translationPart.getY(), dtheta);
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Invert the transformation. This is useful for undoing a transformation.
245   *
246   * @return The inverted transformation.
247   */
248  public Transform2d inverse() {
249    // We are rotating the difference between the translations
250    // using a clockwise rotation matrix. This transforms the global
251    // delta into a local delta (relative to the initial pose).
252    return new Transform2d(
253        getTranslation().unaryMinus().rotateBy(getRotation().unaryMinus()),
254        getRotation().unaryMinus());
255  }
256
257  @Override
258  public String toString() {
259    return String.format("Transform2d(%s, %s)", m_translation, m_rotation);
260  }
261
262  /**
263   * Checks equality between this Transform2d and another object.
264   *
265   * @param obj The other object.
266   * @return Whether the two objects are equal or not.
267   */
268  @Override
269  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
270    return obj instanceof Transform2d other
271        && other.m_translation.equals(m_translation)
272        && other.m_rotation.equals(m_rotation);
273  }
274
275  @Override
276  public int hashCode() {
277    return Objects.hash(m_translation, m_rotation);
278  }
279
280  /** Transform2d protobuf for serialization. */
281  public static final Transform2dProto proto = new Transform2dProto();
282
283  /** Transform2d struct for serialization. */
284  public static final Transform2dStruct struct = new Transform2dStruct();
285}
